notes.title: Game Update!
notes.content:
[b]The following changes and improvements are presented in this update:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Changes made in sound settings:[/b] The music editor has been removed. Instead, a general volume feature has been introduced, allowing to control the sound level in the game.

[*] [b]New levels added:[/b] This expands opportunities for exploration and skill testing.

[*] [b]Joystick control improved:[/b] The joystick control mechanics have been updated and improved for greater intuitiveness and convenience.

[*] [b]Errors fixed in locations:[/b] Errors in locations with infinite jumps have been eliminated. Now all jumps and movements work as intended.

[*] [b]Overall difficulty of levels reduced:[/b] Listening to player feedback, the decision was made to reduce the overall difficulty of the levels. This should make the game more accessible and enjoyable.

[*] [i]We hope these changes will be appreciated. Thank you for playing and your support![/i]
[/list]
